verdict.rationale: Exa documents asynchronous job-style products: async deep research, list building and enrichment (pricing page). Websets run from a query plus a target item count and send real-time HTTP callbacks as items are added or enriched. However, nothing shows a batch endpoint for submitting many search queries at once, or async handling of high-volume raw search workloads, and default rate limits apply. Missing for 10: batch submission of multiple search queries, async/queued mode for the core Search API, documented throughput or limits for batch jobs, independent corroboration.
